source.nativeRuntimePolicy: Exact identities and native instruction phases are clock-driven. An opcode-3-only initial phase remains logically staged and non-resident until its first clock gate. Opcode-5/6 routes repeat; unbracketed routes execute once and hold. A final unbracketed leg exits after arrival, which remains an explicit inference pending complete opcode dispatch recovery.

nativeSchedule.interpretation: opcode 1/2 gates the following phase at its packed clock; opcode 5/6 brackets a repeating patrol; unbracketed node lists execute once and hold, except the final post-clock exit leg; an initial opcode-3-only phase stages the logical record without making its render model resident until the first clock gate

explicitPoseMotion.semanticStatus: opcode 0x2d is [opcode, motionId, flags]. The native dispatcher passes flags | 0x20 to actor layer 1; the layer installer uses bits 0x02/0x04/0x08/0x10 as controller-group masks. This command's single 0x10 bit routes the pose to native motion slot 4 (compact curves 57..68, controllers 18..21) while locomotion remains separately evaluated
